# Report fixtures (synthetic)

Sample outputs of external tools, used only by the adapter tests. `impeccable-detect.json` is the real
output of `impeccable detect --json` (version 0.1.11) on a synthetic page, with the absolute path
rewritten to `/srv/checkout/public`. The others are small hand-written files in the documented
formats of axe-core, Lighthouse, JUnit and TAP. None of them describes a real product.
